<!-- B"H
Boruch Hashem
Blessed is He

The Awtsmoos turns critique into another lamp in the night; Awtsmoos.com must resist easy green checks and demand the actual image bytes, URLs, payloads, and server replies align right.
-->
# Critique — Thirty Finalization Improvements

1. Test current main, not an old sparse branch.
2. Separate ancestry proof from UI behavior proof.
3. Inspect all Olam changes after Better V2 before declaring its behavior preserved.
4. Enumerate routes from source, not memory.
5. Enumerate browser callers from source, not test assumptions.
6. Mock provider fetch to verify exact upstream URL/method/auth/body.
7. Verify missing-key behavior without a paid request.
8. Verify malformed create fails before provider access.
9. Verify task path encoding.
10. Verify error status propagation.
11. Verify text-only concrete ratio.
12. Verify frame adaptive ratio.
13. Verify reference roles by media kind.
14. Verify counts and cumulative durations.
15. Verify image dimensions/aspect ratio.
16. Verify replace keeps stable asset ID.
17. Verify replace preserves metadata users care about.
18. Verify replace changes updatedAt/signature/blob.
19. Verify wrong-kind replacement fails.
20. Verify object URL cache invalidates old version.
21. Verify reload persists replacement.
22. Verify payload contains updated bytes after replacement.
23. Verify remove eliminates outgoing reference.
24. Verify reorder changes outgoing order exactly once.
25. Verify no duplicate references emerge.
26. Verify no browser secret leakage.
27. Verify no console/network errors in normal editing.
28. Verify public production CSS/UI still passes current regressions.
29. Verify production Git/service independently of app HTTP.
30. Clean only processes/worktrees owned by this mission.
